name: @ham2k/qso-parties
description: Every QSO party's rules, counties and dates as QsoPartyParams — one module per event, generated from the sponsors' own files
author: Sebastian Delmont <sd@ham2k.com>
//exports: An extension imports the one party it is — `@ham2k/qso-parties/tx` — which
pulls in that party's county table and nothing else. The root export is the
map of all fifty, for tools and tests; importing it carries every county
`./identities` is the slim view — every party's name, ref type and the
feeds that carry it, no counties — for an extension that reads all fifty
Consumed as TypeScript source, like the engine: esbuild bundles the
extension that reads it, so there is no build step and no dist/.
//dependencies: The engine is a type-only import here: these modules are data, and nothing
